fusions.name: Guard Breaker
fusions.desc: Slams the target for 30 damage that ignores its resistances, and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cut-Off Bite
fusions.desc: Bites for 6 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. You hold up to 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Take the Blow
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 5 seconds. A guard escort fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bulwark Bond
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. The effect grows 6% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
